card.name: The word potent in drug interactions
card.fires_on: The word "potent", both on its own and as the start of "potentiate", in drug-interaction text. It appears before inhibitor, inducer or the rest of the verb.

modes.label: Start of potentiate
modes.description: "potent" is the first piece of "potentiate" when one drug is said to increase another's effect.

modes.label: Potent inhibitor or inducer
modes.description: "potent" describes an enzyme inhibitor or inducer, often after "a" and a named drug such as ketoconazole.
modes.example: co-administration of orally inhaled ciclesonide and oral ketoconazole, a<< potent>> inhibitor of cytochrome P45
